error: The headline claim says its population is all orders, while the spec and its own caveats say delivered orders.
warning_texts: CLM-NET-REVENUE declares population 'all orders inside the period' but its value is computed on delivered orders only; over the stated population the value would be 41881.34, so the population label misdescribes the number and is unverified by any machine rule in audit/check_plan.json.

metrics/calculated_metrics.json states the three country formulas as 'SUM(net_amount) WHERE country = country'; net_amount is a derived column and 'WHERE country = country' is a tautology — cosmetic, values verified correct, but the formulas do not literally describe the computation.
summary: All five claim values independently recomputed from raw_data/orders.csv and match the register (net_revenue 35741.52; rate 0.473684 = 27/57 paying customers; PL 11181.67 / DE 11032.61 / CZ 13527.24, parts sum to headline). One blocker: CLM-NET-REVENUE declares population 'all orders inside the period' while the value is computed on delivered orders only — over the declared population the value would be 41881.34. The machine gate has no population-label rule, so this mislabel passed it and only human judgment catches it.
